knowledge_base.source: Extracted & curated from Physics_Problems_Text_Only.csv CoT analysis

laws.name: Coulomb's Law
laws.description: Force between two point charges

laws.name: Electric Field from point charge
laws.description: Electric field magnitude at distance r from charge q

laws.name: Superposition Principle
laws.description: Net force/field is vector sum of individual contributions
laws.note: Must add as VECTORS, not scalars

laws.name: Resultant of two forces — same direction
laws.description: Forces in same direction: add magnitudes

laws.name: Resultant of two perpendicular forces
laws.description: Pythagorean theorem for perpendicular forces

laws.name: Resultant of two forces at angle theta
laws.description: Law of cosines for force composition

laws.name: Force on test charge in E field
laws.description: Force on charge q0 placed in electric field E

laws.name: Force on a third charge by two source charges
laws.formula: F13 = k*|q1*q3|/CA^2; F23 = k*|q2*q3|/CB^2; F_net = vector_sum(F13, F23)
laws.description: Use when a third/test charge q3 is placed at point C and the question asks for the force acting on q3. Compute each Coulomb force and add as vectors.
laws.note: Do not use point-where-E=0 or point-where-V=0 formulas for this task unless the question explicitly asks for such a point.

laws.name: Direction of Coulomb force by charge signs
laws.formula: same signs repel; opposite signs attract
laws.description: Use before vector addition. Determine whether each force on the test charge points toward or away from the source charge.
laws.note: For collinear A-C-B geometry, if both forces on q3 point the same way then add magnitudes; if they point opposite ways then subtract magnitudes.

laws.name: Collinear geometry for three points
laws.formula: if CA + CB = AB then C lies between A and B
laws.description: Use to infer the line geometry in Coulomb force problems with distances AB, CA, and CB.
laws.note: Once geometry is known, combine Coulomb forces by direction along the line.

laws.name: Net Coulomb force with angle at the test charge
laws.description: Use when two Coulomb force vectors acting on the same charge form an angle theta at that charge.
laws.units: F [N], theta [rad or degree converted before cos]

laws.name: Point where E = 0 (two charges same sign)
laws.description: Use only when the question asks for the point/location where net electric field is zero. For same-sign charges, the zero-field point lies between them.

laws.name: Point where E = 0 (two charges opposite sign)
laws.formula: k*|q1|/r1^2 = k*|q2|/r2^2, outside the segment (closer to smaller charge)
laws.description: Use only when the question asks for the point/location where net electric field is zero. For opposite-sign charges, the zero-field point lies outside the segment on the side of the smaller charge.

laws.name: Inductive reactance
laws.formula: X_L = omega * L = 2 * pi * f * L

laws.name: Voltage across components
laws.formula: U_R = I*R,  U_L = I*X_L,  U_C = I*X_C
laws.description: Voltage across resistor, inductor, capacitor

laws.name: Active (real) power
laws.formula: P = U * I * cos(phi) = I^2 * R

laws.name: Power factor
laws.description: dimensionless [0, 1]

laws.name: Resonance condition
laws.description: At resonance: Z_min = R, I_max = U/R

laws.name: Quality factor
laws.description: dimensionless, measures sharpness of resonance

laws.name: Total energy conservation in LC
laws.description: Total energy is constant (no resistance)

laws.name: Charge as function of time
laws.description: Oscillating charge on capacitor

laws.name: When W_C = W_L (equal energy split)
laws.formula: U = U_max / sqrt(2),  I = I_max / sqrt(2)
laws.description: At this moment half energy in each component

laws.name: Capacitors in series
laws.description: Same charge on each, voltages add

laws.name: Capacitors in parallel
laws.description: Same voltage across each, charges add

laws.name: Effect of dielectric (disconnected from source)
laws.formula: Q = const, C_new = epsilon * C0, U_new = Q / C_new = U0 / epsilon, W_new = W0 / epsilon
laws.description: Disconnected: Q unchanged, U and W decrease

laws.name: Effect of dielectric (connected to source)
laws.formula: U = const, C_new = epsilon * C0, Q_new = C_new * U, W_new = epsilon * W0
laws.description: Connected: U unchanged, Q and W increase

laws.name: Merging capacitors (like-sign plates together)
laws.description: Total charge divided by total capacitance

laws.name: Merging capacitors (unlike-sign plates together)
laws.description: Charge difference divided by total capacitance

laws.name: Average induced EMF
laws.description: Used when flux changes uniformly

laws.name: Absolute error
laws.description: Absolute deviation from true value

laws.name: Relative error (percentage error)
laws.description: Ratio of absolute error to value, expressed as %

laws.name: Instrument error
laws.description: LCNS = Least Count (smallest division). In Vietnamese physics, instrument error equals the FULL least count.

laws.name: Mean value from repeated measurements
laws.description: Average of n measurements

laws.name: Random error (max deviation)
laws.description: Maximum absolute deviation from the mean. Vietnamese standard uses MAX, not average deviation.

laws.name: Total measurement error
laws.description: The total error is the larger of random error and instrument error

laws.name: Error propagation — sum/difference
laws.formula: Z = X ± Y  =>  Delta_Z = Delta_X + Delta_Y
laws.description: Errors always ADD for sum or difference

laws.name: Error propagation — product/quotient
laws.formula: Z = X * Y or X/Y  =>  delta_Z = delta_X + delta_Y
laws.description: Relative errors add for multiplication/division

laws.name: Error propagation — power
laws.description: Multiply relative error by the exponent

laws.name: Resistance from V and I
laws.formula: R = U / I,  delta_R = delta_U + delta_I
laws.description: Ohm's law with error propagation

laws.name: Power error propagation
laws.formula: P = V * I,  delta_P = delta_V + delta_I
laws.description: Power measurement error

laws.name: Superposition of potential
laws.formula: V_total = V1 + V2 + ... (scalar, not vector sum)
laws.description: Potential is SCALAR — just add algebraically

laws.name: Voltage (potential difference)
laws.description: Potential difference between points A and B

laws.name: Relation between E and V along field line
laws.formula: E = -dV/dr  (or U_AB = E * d for uniform field)
laws.description: E points from high V to low V

laws.name: E ratio at two points on same field line
laws.description: Point charge: E inversely proportional to r squared

laws.name: Point where V = 0 (two opposite charges)
laws.description: For charges +q and -q: point divides distance in ratio |q1|:|q2|

laws.name: Resonance condition
laws.description: Verify by computing both reactances and comparing

laws.name: At resonance: minimum impedance
laws.description: Reactive components cancel exactly

laws.name: At resonance: maximum current
laws.description: Current is maximum at resonance

laws.name: At resonance: maximum power
laws.description: All power consumed by resistance

laws.name: Quality factor
laws.formula: Q_factor = omega_0 * L / R = 1 / (omega_0 * C * R)
laws.description: Higher Q = sharper resonance peak

laws.name: Yes/No resonance answer format
laws.formula: Compare f_given with f_0 = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(L*C)) using tolerance
laws.description: For Yes/No resonance questions: answer must be the string 'Yes' or 'No', not True/False or a number. Unit is '-'.

unit_conversions.description: Always convert to SI before calculation
